scope: Complete visual inspection of every page in the cumulative Indonesian PDF through Unit 19 after the Unit 18 caption and Unit 19 Christoffel and Brioschi display reflows.

render_evidence.inventory_digest_method: SHA-256 over UTF-8 filename|bytes|sha256 lines in sorted order, each terminated by LF
render_evidence.inspection: All eleven contact sheets covering pages 1-302 were inspected. Because the final sheet contains only pages 301-302 and is sparse, both final pages were additionally inspected at full rendered resolution. Repaired pages 273, 289, 290, and 293 were also inspected at full rendered resolution.

focused_reflow_evidence.finding: The Unit 18 Hyperboloid2 caption, the Unit 19 Christoffel expansion, and both Brioschi determinant displays are legible, centered, full-size, and wholly inside the text block. The last media-attribution and license pages are complete and readable.

limitations: This is a visual-rendering receipt, not a claim that the PDF is structurally tagged; the structural receipt records the untagged-PDF limitation separately.
The bound TeX logs contain 42 non-blocking box diagnostics, while independent page-bound, body-extent, full-render, and visual checks pass.
Hollow square marks visible in the reader are intentional proof-ending marks, not missing-glyph placeholders.
